structured_output.mechanisms: Time is about 1.1 s fixed overhead plus samples processed times per-sample cost. Per-sample cost grows with the stage-2/3 channel product, is cut by the low-res phase fraction (about 44% cheaper at 24px), and falls slightly with larger batch. Muon adds a small fixed cost. Accuracy saturates with epochs and capacity, drops steeply when capacity is cut, and drops past a knee in low-res fraction. Cutout, random flip, translate4 and extra label smoothing hurt. Muon on conv filters helps.
